thread:
ana: FYI sampleapp onboarding CI red after the latest openapi tweak. regen-diff flagged but diff looks like ordering/docs only.

leo: Can you paste the CI snippet?

ana: (typo) ana: Pasted: ```
tools/typegen/check-regen --path packages/clients/ts
regen-diff detected: packages/clients/ts/src/generated/onboard.ts
expected: 0x9caf
actual: 0x9d11
```

chris: This smells like non-semantic churn from the formatter we ran on the spec. Did someone run autoprezero? :grimacing:

ana: @chris not autoprezero, but openapi-cli v2.4.1 did reflow the description fields. The generator emits JSDoc in a different order now.

leo: If it's only JSDoc/property ordering we should avoid a semver bump. The current semver-check in tools/typegen treats any AST diff as minor. We need a rule change.

marie: Meanwhile the onboarding e2e hangs because the sampleapp ci uses the latest generated client. Can we pin to the last good generated artifact in CI? Quick unblock.

ryan: I'd prefer a less manual fix: add a generator mode `--stable-output` that canonicalizes property order and strips non-code comments used for docs during hashing. That will keep the published artifact identical across formatting runs.

qa-bot: flake-detect: Found 2 failing tests in sampleapp/onboard e2e (auth/retry timing, UI assertion). See https://ci.internal/redwood/sampleapp/5234 :x: 

chris: `--stable-output` sounds good but is more engineering work. Quick plan: (A) pin CI to generated artifact hash abcde123 (hotfix) (B) patch semver-check to ignore JSDoc/property-order diffs (C) implement stable-output in typegen for long term.

leo: For (B) we should define the comparator precisely: ignore reordering of object properties, comments/javadoc whitespace, and stable-sort arrays where key is present. Treat added/removed fields or optional->required as semver-minor/major triggers.

ana: I'll open the pin PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/300 (temporary pin to abcde123).

ryan: I'll sketch an RFC for `--stable-output` (tools/typegen/rfcs/0007-stable-output.md) and include compatibility tests.

marie: Also let's add a tiny onboarding doc blurb: how to run `tools/typegen/hash-report --path <pkg>` and what to do when you hit a regen-diff. New hires keep tripping on this.

chris: Good. Action items: ana open pin PR merged fast, leo update semver-check heuristics (unit tests), ryan RFC + stable-output prototype, marie docs blurb + sampleapp CI note. I'll review all.

ana: Pin PR opened and linked in ticket INF-2029.

qa-bot: CI note: Re-run required after pin merged.

leo: I'll start the semver-check change. Quick test plan: create synthetic diffs (reordered props, changed comments) and verify semver decision remains unchanged.

ryan: For visibility, I'll add a lint/CI job that runs `tools/typegen/hash-report` pre/post openapi-cli formatting to catch this in PRs.

marie: Thanks all. Less churn would be great but this plan should keep onboarding green while we harden tooling.

chris: One more: we should add a short note in release playbook about when to publish a patch vs minor after generator-only changes. People keep defaulting to minor.

ana: Agree. I'll update RELEASES.md with a section and link to the semver-check tests.

ryan: End of thread — updating INF-2029 with PR links and actions.
